text:
Tokyo, one night in Hakone, then Kyoto?
Send the big suitcase straight to Kyoto 👇

✅ Quick check before you book 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hakone-big-suitcase-forward-carry-store

🧳 Option 1: forward it
Yamato's own search showed next-day delivery.
Shinjuku on Tue 15 Dec, Kyoto on Wed 16 Dec.
A 160 cm case costs ¥3,160.

🚃 Option 2: the Hakone-Yumoto desk
Drop it between 8:30 and 12:00.
It reaches your hotel after 15:00.
¥1,500 regular, ¥2,500 large, one way.

🔒 Option 3: a locker at Odawara
L lockers in the Shinkansen passage, ¥800 a day.
The day starts at 2 a.m.,
so one night costs about ¥1,600.

✅ Our take: forward it,
and pack a small bag for the ryokan.

👉 The bag-free last morning trick:
https://japanbystation.com/hakone-big-suitcase-forward-carry-store

Would you trust a courier with your suitcase? 👇
